question.text: Lock-up agreement restrictions for research analysts who were managers of a public offering prohibit publishing research for:

answer.text: 25 days before and 25 days after lock-up expiry
15 days prior to entering into the lock-up agreement and 15 days after its expiration, waiver, or termination
40 days total around the lock-up period
No restriction related to lock-up periods

explanation.text: The Logic: The rule prohibits publishing research 15 days prior to the date of entering into the lock-up agreement and 15 days after its expiration, waiver, or termination, subject to the compliance approval exception. The Trap: Framing the window as "15 days before and 15 days after lock-up expiry" misstates the source: the prior period attaches to entering into the agreement, not to its expiry. Note: Two distinct 15-day windows apply: one around the date of entering into the lock-up agreement, and one around its expiration, waiver, or termination.
